identification: Two small round-top timber occasional tables / plant stands (description: 2 TIMBER OCCASIONAL TABLES). Left: heavy 1970s-style table with thick round top in edge-laminated or block-built timber, chunky turned baluster pedestal on a wide round foot, medium-dark stain (looks like oak or similar). Right: handmade-looking table with round moulded-edge top and a flat-slab pedestal with four cut-out shaped splayed legs, polished mid-brown (possibly mahogany/Tasmanian blackwood or similar). Both small, likely 45-60 cm tall.
